1.web: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
1.kjv: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;
1.bsb: This is the beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

1.web: As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you:
1.kjv: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
1.bsb: As it is written in Isaiah the prophet: “Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way.”

1.web: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’”
1.kjv: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
1.bsb: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.’”

1.web: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.
1.kjv: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
1.bsb: John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.

1.web: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.
1.kjv: And there went out unto him all the land of Judæa, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
1.bsb: People went out to him from all of Jerusalem and the countryside of Judea. Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.

1.web: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.
1.kjv: And John was clothed with camel’s hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;
1.bsb: John was clothed in camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

1.web: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the thong of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.
1.kjv: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
1.bsb: And he began to proclaim: “After me will come One more powerful than I, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.

1.web: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”
1.kjv: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
1.bsb: I baptize you with water, but He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.”

1.web: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
1.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
1.bsb: In those days Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

1.web: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting, and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
1.kjv: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:
1.bsb: As soon as Jesus came up out of the water, He saw the heavens breaking open and the Spirit descending on Him like a dove.

1.web: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
1.kjv: And there came a voice from heaven, saying , Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
1.bsb: And a voice came from heaven: “You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.”

1.web: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.
1.kjv: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.
1.bsb: At once the Spirit drove Jesus into the wilderness,

1.web: He was there in the wilderness forty days tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.
1.kjv: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
1.bsb: and He was there for forty days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and the angels ministered to Him.

1.web: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,
1.kjv: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,
1.bsb: After the arrest of John, Jesus went into Galilee and proclaimed the gospel of God.

1.web: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”
1.kjv: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
1.bsb: “The time is fulfilled,” He said, “and the kingdom of God is near. Repent and believe in the gospel!”

1.web: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
1.kjv: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
1.bsb: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, He saw Simon and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

1.web: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”
1.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
1.bsb: “Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”

1.web: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.
1.kjv: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.
1.bsb: And at once they left their nets and followed Him.

1.web: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.
1.kjv: And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
1.bsb: Going on a little farther, He saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat, mending their nets.

1.web: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.
1.kjv: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.
1.bsb: Immediately Jesus called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed Him.

1.web: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.
1.kjv: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.
1.bsb: Then Jesus and His companions went to Capernaum, and right away Jesus entered the synagogue on the Sabbath and began to teach.

1.web: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
1.kjv: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.
1.bsb: The people were astonished at His teaching, because He taught as one who had authority, and not as the scribes.

1.web: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,
1.kjv: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
1.bsb: Suddenly a man with an unclean spirit cried out in the synagogue:

1.web: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!”
1.kjv: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
1.bsb: “What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!”

1.web: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”
1.kjv: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
1.bsb: But Jesus rebuked the spirit. “Be silent!” He said. “Come out of him!”

1.web: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
1.kjv: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
1.bsb: At this, the unclean spirit threw the man into convulsions and came out with a loud shriek.

1.web: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? A new teaching? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”
1.kjv: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.
1.bsb: All the people were amazed and began to ask one another, “What is this? A new teaching with authority! He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him!”

1.web: The report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.
1.kjv: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
1.bsb: And the news about Jesus spread quickly through the whole region of Galilee.

1.web: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
1.kjv: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
1.bsb: As soon as Jesus and His companions had left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.

1.web: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.
1.kjv: But Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.
1.bsb: Simon’s mother-in-law was sick in bed with a fever, and they promptly told Jesus about her.

1.web: He came and took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her, and she served them.
1.kjv: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
1.bsb: So He went to her, took her by the hand, and helped her up. The fever left her, and she began to serve them.

1.web: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick, and those who were possessed by demons.
1.kjv: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.
1.bsb: That evening, after sunset, people brought to Jesus all who were sick and demon-possessed,

1.web: All the city was gathered together at the door.
1.kjv: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
1.bsb: and the whole town gathered at the door.

1.web: He healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.
1.kjv: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.
1.bsb: And He healed many who were ill with various diseases and drove out many demons. But He would not allow the demons to speak, because they knew who He was.

1.web: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.
1.kjv: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
1.bsb: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up and slipped out to a solitary place to pray.

1.web: Simon and those who were with him followed after him;
1.kjv: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.
1.bsb: Simon and his companions went to look for Him,

1.web: and they found him, and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”
1.kjv: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.
1.bsb: and when they found Him, they said, “Everyone is looking for You!”

1.web: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”
1.kjv: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.
1.bsb: But Jesus answered, “Let us go on to the neighboring towns so I can preach there as well, for that is why I have come.”

1.web: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.
1.kjv: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.
1.bsb: So He went throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.

1.web: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”
1.kjv: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
1.bsb: Then a leper came to Jesus, begging on his knees: “If You are willing, You can make me clean.”

1.web: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”
1.kjv: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
1.bsb: Moved with compassion, Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!”

1.web: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.
1.kjv: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.
1.bsb: And immediately the leprosy left him, and the man was cleansed.

1.web: He strictly warned him, and immediately sent him out,
1.kjv: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
1.bsb: Jesus promptly sent him away with a stern warning:

1.web: and said to him, “See you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
1.kjv: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
1.bsb: “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and present the offering Moses prescribed for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”

1.web: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places: and they came to him from everywhere.
1.kjv: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
1.bsb: But the man went out and openly began to proclaim and spread the news. Consequently, Jesus could no longer enter a town in plain view, but He stayed out in solitary places. Yet people came to Him from every quarter.

2.web: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was in the house.
2.kjv: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.
2.bsb: A few days later Jesus went back to Capernaum. And when the people heard that He was home,

2.web: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.
2.kjv: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them , no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.
2.bsb: they gathered in such large numbers that there was no more room, not even outside the door, as Jesus spoke the word to them.

2.web: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.
2.kjv: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.
2.bsb: Then a paralytic was brought to Him, carried by four men.

2.web: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.
2.kjv: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.
2.bsb: Since they were unable to get to Jesus through the crowd, they uncovered the roof above Him, made an opening, and lowered the paralytic on his mat.

2.web: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”
2.kjv: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.
2.bsb: When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”

2.web: But there were some of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
2.kjv: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
2.bsb: But some of the scribes were sitting there and thinking in their hearts,

2.web: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
2.kjv: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
2.bsb: “Why does this man speak like this? He is blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

2.web: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?
2.kjv: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?
2.bsb: At once Jesus knew in His spirit that they were thinking this way within themselves. “Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?” He asked.

2.web: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk?’
2.kjv: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?
2.bsb: “Which is easier: to say to a paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, pick up your mat, and walk’?

2.web: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—
2.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)
2.bsb: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...” He said to the paralytic,

2.web: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”
2.kjv: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.
2.bsb: “I tell you, get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”

2.web: He arose, and immediately took up the mat, and went out in front of them all; so that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”
2.kjv: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
2.bsb: And immediately the man got up, picked up his mat, and walked out in front of them all. As a result, they were all astounded and glorified God, saying, “We have never seen anything like this!”

2.web: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.
2.kjv: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
2.bsb: Once again Jesus went out beside the sea. All the people came to Him, and He taught them there.

2.web: As he passed by, he saw Levi, the son of Alphaeus, sitting at the tax office, and he said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.
2.kjv: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphæus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
2.bsb: As He was walking along, He saw Levi son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax booth. “Follow Me,” He told him, and Levi got up and followed Him.

2.web: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.
2.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
2.bsb: While Jesus was dining at Levi’s house, many tax collectors and sinners were eating with Him and His disciples—for there were many who followed Him.

2.web: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”
2.kjv: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?
2.bsb: When the scribes who were Pharisees saw Jesus eating with these people, they asked His disciples, “Why does He eat with tax collectors and sinners?”

2.web: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”
2.kjv: When Jesus heard it , he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
2.bsb: On hearing this, Jesus told them, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”

2.web: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”
2.kjv: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?
2.bsb: Now John’s disciples and the Pharisees were often fasting. So people came to Jesus and asked, “Why don’t Your disciples fast like John’s disciples and those of the Pharisees?”

2.web: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.
2.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
2.bsb: Jesus replied, “How can the guests of the bridegroom fast while He is with them? As long as He is with them, they cannot fast.

2.web: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then will they fast in that day.
2.kjv: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
2.bsb: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.

2.web: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.
2.kjv: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.
2.bsb: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. If he does, the new piece will pull away from the old, and a worse tear will result.

2.web: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”
2.kjv: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.
2.bsb: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. Instead, new wine is poured into new wineskins.”

2.web: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields, and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.
2.kjv: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.
2.bsb: One Sabbath Jesus was passing through the grainfields, and His disciples began to pick the heads of grain as they walked along.

2.web: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”
2.kjv: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?
2.bsb: So the Pharisees said to Him, “Look, why are they doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”

2.web: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did, when he had need, and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?
2.kjv: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?
2.bsb: Jesus replied, “Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry and in need?

2.web: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”
2.kjv: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?
2.bsb: During the high priesthood of Abiathar, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which was lawful only for the priests. And he gave some to his companions as well.”

2.web: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
2.kjv: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
2.bsb: Then Jesus declared, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

2.web: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”
2.kjv: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
2.bsb: Therefore, the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.”

3.web: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there who had his hand withered.
3.kjv: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.
3.bsb: Once again Jesus entered the synagogue, and a man with a withered hand was there.

3.web: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.
3.kjv: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.
3.bsb: In order to accuse Jesus, they were watching to see if He would heal on the Sabbath.

3.web: He said to the man who had his hand withered, “Stand up.”
3.kjv: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.
3.bsb: Then Jesus said to the man with the withered hand, “Stand up among us.”

3.web: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?” But they were silent.
3.kjv: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.
3.bsb: And He asked them, “Which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?” But they were silent.

3.web: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.
3.kjv: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
3.bsb: Jesus looked around at them with anger and sorrow at their hardness of heart. Then He said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” So he stretched it out, and it was restored.

3.web: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
3.kjv: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
3.bsb: At this, the Pharisees went out and began plotting with the Herodians how they might kill Jesus.

3.web: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples, and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,
3.kjv: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judæa,
3.bsb: So Jesus withdrew with His disciples to the sea, accompanied by a large crowd from Galilee, Judea,

3.web: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.
3.kjv: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.
3.bsb: Jerusalem, Idumea, the region beyond the Jordan, and the vicinity of Tyre and Sidon. The large crowd came to Him when they heard what great things He was doing.

3.web: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.
3.kjv: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.
3.bsb: Jesus asked His disciples to have a boat ready for Him so that the crowd would not crush Him.

3.web: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.
3.kjv: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.
3.bsb: For He had healed so many that all who had diseases were pressing forward to touch Him.

3.web: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, “You are the Son of God!”
3.kjv: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.
3.bsb: And when the unclean spirits saw Him, they fell down before Him and cried out, “You are the Son of God!”

3.web: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.
3.kjv: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.
3.bsb: But He warned them sternly not to make Him known.

3.web: He went up into the mountain, and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.
3.kjv: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.
3.bsb: Then Jesus went up on the mountain and called for those He wanted, and they came to Him.

3.web: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach,
3.kjv: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
3.bsb: He appointed twelve of them, whom He designated as apostles, to accompany Him, to be sent out to preach,

3.web: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:
3.kjv: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:
3.bsb: and to have authority to drive out demons.

3.web: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);
3.kjv: And Simon he surnamed Peter;
3.bsb: These are the twelve He appointed: Simon (whom He named Peter),

3.web: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);
3.kjv: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:
3.bsb: James son of Zebedee and his brother John (whom He named Boanerges, meaning “Sons of Thunder”),

3.web: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;
3.kjv: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,
3.bsb: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot,

3.web: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.
3.kjv: And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.
3.bsb: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus.

3.web: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
3.kjv: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
3.bsb: Then Jesus went home, and once again a crowd gathered, so that He and His disciples could not even eat.

3.web: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him: for they said, “He is insane.”
3.kjv: And when his friends heard of it , they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.
3.bsb: When His family heard about this, they went out to take custody of Him, saying, “He is out of His mind.”

3.web: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”
3.kjv: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.
3.bsb: And the scribes who had come down from Jerusalem were saying, “He is possessed by Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons He drives out demons.”

3.web: He summoned them, and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?
3.kjv: And he called them unto him , and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
3.bsb: So Jesus called them together and began to speak to them in parables: “How can Satan drive out Satan?

3.web: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
3.kjv: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
3.bsb: If a kingdom is divided against itself, it cannot stand.

3.web: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
3.kjv: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
3.bsb: If a house is divided against itself, it cannot stand.

3.web: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.
3.kjv: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.
3.bsb: And if Satan is divided and rises against himself, he cannot stand; his end has come.

3.web: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder, unless he first binds the strong man; and then he will plunder his house.
3.kjv: No man can enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
3.bsb: Indeed, no one can enter a strong man’s house to steal his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man. Then he can plunder his house.

3.web: Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;
3.kjv: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:
3.bsb: Truly I tell you, the sons of men will be forgiven all sins and blasphemies, as many as they utter.

3.web: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”
3.kjv: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:
3.bsb: But whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; he is guilty of eternal sin.”

3.web: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”
3.kjv: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
3.bsb: Jesus made this statement because they were saying, “He has an unclean spirit.”

3.web: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.
3.kjv: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.
3.bsb: Then Jesus’ mother and brothers came and stood outside. They sent someone in to summon Him,

3.web: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”
3.kjv: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
3.bsb: and a crowd was sitting around Him. “Look,” He was told, “Your mother and brothers are outside, asking for You.”

3.web: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”
3.kjv: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?
3.bsb: But Jesus replied, “Who are My mother and My brothers?”

3.web: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!
3.kjv: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
3.bsb: Looking at those seated in a circle around Him, He said, “Here are My mother and My brothers!

3.web: For whoever does the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.”
3.kjv: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
3.bsb: For whoever does the will of God is My brother and sister and mother.”

4.web: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea, and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.
4.kjv: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.
4.bsb: Once again Jesus began to teach beside the sea, and such a large crowd gathered around Him that He got into a boat and sat in it, while all the people crowded along the shore.

4.web: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,
4.kjv: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,
4.bsb: And He taught them many things in parables, and in His teaching He said,

4.web: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow,
4.kjv: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:
4.bsb: “Listen! A farmer went out to sow his seed.

4.web: and as he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.
4.kjv: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.
4.bsb: And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.

4.web: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.
4.kjv: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:
4.bsb: Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.

4.web: When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
4.kjv: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
4.bsb: But when the sun rose, the seedlings were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.

4.web: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
4.kjv: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
4.bsb: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings, and they yielded no crop.

4.web: Others fell into the good ground, and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”
4.kjv: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.
4.bsb: Still other seed fell on good soil, where it sprouted, grew up, and produced a crop—one bearing thirtyfold, another sixtyfold, and another a hundredfold.”

4.web: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.”
4.kjv: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
4.bsb: Then Jesus said, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

4.web: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.
4.kjv: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.
4.bsb: As soon as Jesus was alone with the Twelve and those around Him, they asked Him about the parable.

4.web: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,
4.kjv: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:
4.bsb: He replied, “The mystery of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to those on the outside everything is expressed in parables,

4.web: that ‘seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”
4.kjv: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.
4.bsb: so that, ‘they may be ever seeing but never perceiving, and ever hearing but never understanding; otherwise they might turn and be forgiven.’”

4.web: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?
4.kjv: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?
4.bsb: Then Jesus said to them, “Do you not understand this parable? Then how will you understand any of the parables?

4.web: The farmer sows the word.
4.kjv: The sower soweth the word.
4.bsb: The farmer sows the word.

4.web: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes, and takes away the word which has been sown in them.
4.kjv: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.
4.bsb: Some are like the seeds along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.

4.web: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.
4.kjv: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
4.bsb: Some are like the seeds sown on rocky ground. They hear the word and at once receive it with joy.

4.web: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.
4.kjv: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word’s sake, immediately they are offended.
4.bsb: But they themselves have no root, and they remain for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.

4.web: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,
4.kjv: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,
4.bsb: Others are like the seeds sown among the thorns. They hear the word,

4.web: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
4.kjv: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.
4.bsb: but the worries of this life, the deceitfulness of wealth, and the desire for other things come in and choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

4.web: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, and accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”
4.kjv: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it , and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
4.bsb: Still others are like the seeds sown on good soil. They hear the word, receive it, and produce a crop—thirtyfold, sixtyfold, or a hundredfold.”

4.web: He said to them, “Is the lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?
4.kjv: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?
4.bsb: Jesus also said to them, “Does anyone bring in a lamp to put it under a basket or under a bed? Doesn’t he set it on a stand?

4.web: For there is nothing hidden, except that it should be made known; neither was anything made secret, but that it should come to light.
4.kjv: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
4.bsb: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be brought to light.

4.web: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”
4.kjv: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
4.bsb: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear.”

4.web: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you, and more will be given to you who hear.
4.kjv: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.
4.bsb: He went on to say, “Pay attention to what you hear. With the measure you use, it will be measured to you, and even more will be added to you.

4.web: For whoever has, to him will more be given, and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”
4.kjv: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.
4.bsb: For whoever has will be given more. But whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.”

4.web: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,
4.kjv: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;
4.bsb: Jesus also said, “The kingdom of God is like a man who scatters seed on the ground.

4.web: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.
4.kjv: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.
4.bsb: Night and day he sleeps and wakes, and the seed sprouts and grows, though he knows not how.

4.web: For the earth bears fruit: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.
4.kjv: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
4.bsb: All by itself the earth produces a crop—first the stalk, then the head, then grain that ripens within.

4.web: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”
4.kjv: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.
4.bsb: And as soon as the grain is ripe, he swings the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

4.web: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?
4.kjv: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?
4.bsb: Then He asked, “To what can we compare the kingdom of God? With what parable shall we present it?

4.web: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,
4.kjv: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
4.bsb: It is like a mustard seed, which is the smallest of all seeds sown upon the earth.

4.web: yet when it is sown, grows up, and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”
4.kjv: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.
4.bsb: But after it is planted, it grows to be the largest of all garden plants and puts forth great branches, so that the birds of the air nest in its shade.”

4.web: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.
4.kjv: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it .
4.bsb: With many such parables Jesus spoke the word to them, to the extent that they could understand.

4.web: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
4.kjv: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
4.bsb: He did not tell them anything without using a parable. But privately He explained everything to His own disciples.

4.web: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”
4.kjv: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.
4.bsb: When that evening came, He said to His disciples, “Let us cross to the other side.”

4.web: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.
4.kjv: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.
4.bsb: After they had dismissed the crowd, they took Jesus with them, since He was already in the boat. And there were other boats with Him.

4.web: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.
4.kjv: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
4.bsb: Soon a violent windstorm came up, and the waves were breaking over the boat, so that it was being swamped.

4.web: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion, and they woke him up, and told him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”
4.kjv: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?
4.bsb: But Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on the cushion. So they woke Him and said, “Teacher, don’t You care that we are perishing?”

4.web: He awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
4.kjv: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
4.bsb: Then Jesus got up and rebuked the wind and the sea. “Silence!” He commanded. “Be still!” And the wind died down, and it was perfectly calm.

4.web: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”
4.kjv: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?
4.bsb: “Why are you so afraid?” He asked. “Do you still have no faith?”

4.web: They were greatly afraid, and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
4.kjv: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
4.bsb: Overwhelmed with fear, they asked one another, “Who is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?”

5.web: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
5.kjv: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
5.bsb: On the other side of the sea, they arrived in the region of the Gerasenes.

5.web: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.
5.kjv: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
5.bsb: As soon as Jesus got out of the boat, He was met by a man with an unclean spirit, who was coming from the tombs.

5.web: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,
5.kjv: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
5.bsb: This man had been living in the tombs and could no longer be restrained, even with chains.

5.web: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.
5.kjv: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.
5.bsb: Though he was often bound with chains and shackles, he had broken the chains and shattered the shackles. Now there was no one with the strength to subdue him.

5.web: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.
5.kjv: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
5.bsb: Night and day in the tombs and in the mountains he kept crying out and cutting himself with stones.

5.web: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,
5.kjv: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,
5.bsb: When the man saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees before Him.

5.web: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”
5.kjv: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.
5.bsb: And he shouted in a loud voice, “What do You want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You before God not to torture me!”

5.web: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”
5.kjv: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.
5.bsb: For Jesus had already declared, “Come out of this man, you unclean spirit!”

5.web: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”
5.kjv: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
5.bsb: “What is your name?” Jesus asked. “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”

5.web: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
5.kjv: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
5.bsb: And he begged Jesus repeatedly not to send them out of that region.

5.web: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.
5.kjv: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.
5.bsb: There on the nearby hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding.

5.web: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”
5.kjv: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
5.bsb: So the demons begged Jesus, “Send us to the pigs, so that we may enter them.”

5.web: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.
5.kjv: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
5.bsb: He gave them permission, and the unclean spirits came out and went into the pigs, and the herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea and drowned in the water.

5.web: Those who fed them fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.
5.kjv: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
5.bsb: Those tending the pigs ran off and reported this in the town and countryside, and the people went out to see what had happened.

5.web: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.
5.kjv: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
5.bsb: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons sitting there, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

5.web: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.
5.kjv: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
5.bsb: Those who had seen it described what had happened to the demon-possessed man and also to the pigs.

5.web: They began to beg him to depart from their region.
5.kjv: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.
5.bsb: And the people began to beg Jesus to leave their region.

5.web: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.
5.kjv: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
5.bsb: As He was getting into the boat, the man who had been possessed by the demons begged to go with Him.

5.web: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you, and how he had mercy on you.”
5.kjv: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.
5.bsb: But Jesus would not allow him. “Go home to your own people,” He said, “and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and what mercy He has shown you.”

5.web: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.
5.kjv: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.
5.bsb: So the man went away and began to proclaim throughout the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him. And everyone was amazed.

5.web: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.
5.kjv: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.
5.bsb: When Jesus had again crossed by boat to the other side, a large crowd gathered around Him beside the sea.

5.web: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet,
5.kjv: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
5.bsb: A synagogue leader named Jairus arrived, and seeing Jesus, he fell at His feet

5.web: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”
5.kjv: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee , come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
5.bsb: and pleaded with Him urgently, “My little daughter is near death. Please come and place Your hands on her, so that she will be healed and live.”

5.web: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.
5.kjv: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.
5.bsb: So Jesus went with him, and a large crowd followed and pressed around Him.

5.web: A certain woman, who had an issue of blood for twelve years,
5.kjv: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
5.bsb: And a woman was there who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years.

5.web: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,
5.kjv: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
5.bsb: She had borne much agony under the care of many physicians and had spent all she had, but to no avail. Instead, her condition had only grown worse.

5.web: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd, and touched his clothes.
5.kjv: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.
5.bsb: When the woman heard about Jesus, she came up through the crowd behind Him and touched His cloak.

5.web: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”
5.kjv: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.
5.bsb: For she kept saying, “If only I touch His garments, I will be healed.”

5.web: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
5.kjv: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
5.bsb: Immediately her bleeding stopped, and she sensed in her body that she was healed of her affliction.

5.web: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd, and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”
5.kjv: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?
5.bsb: At once Jesus was aware that power had gone out from Him. Turning to the crowd, He asked, “Who touched My garments?”

5.web: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”
5.kjv: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
5.bsb: His disciples answered, “You can see the crowd pressing in on You, and yet You ask, ‘Who touched Me?’”

5.web: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.
5.kjv: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
5.bsb: But He kept looking around to see who had done this.

5.web: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
5.kjv: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
5.bsb: Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell down before Him trembling in fear, and she told Him the whole truth.

5.web: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”
5.kjv: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
5.bsb: “Daughter,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be free of your affliction.”

5.web: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”
5.kjv: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue’s house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?
5.bsb: While He was still speaking, messengers from the house of Jairus arrived and said, “Your daughter is dead; why bother the Teacher anymore?”

5.web: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”
5.kjv: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.
5.bsb: But Jesus overheard their conversation and said to Jairus, “Do not be afraid; just believe.”

5.web: He allowed no one to follow him, except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
5.kjv: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
5.bsb: And He did not allow anyone to accompany Him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

5.web: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.
5.kjv: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.
5.bsb: When they arrived at the house of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw the commotion and the people weeping and wailing loudly.

5.web: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”
5.kjv: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.
5.bsb: He went inside and asked, “Why all this commotion and weeping? The child is not dead, but asleep.”

5.web: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.
5.kjv: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.
5.bsb: And they laughed at Him. After He had put them all outside, He took the child’s father and mother and His own companions, and went in to see the child.

5.web: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”
5.kjv: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.
5.bsb: Taking her by the hand, Jesus said, “Talitha koum!” which means, “Little girl, I say to you, get up!”

5.web: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.
5.kjv: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
5.bsb: Immediately the girl got up and began to walk around. She was twelve years old, and at once they were utterly astounded.

5.web: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.
5.kjv: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
5.bsb: Then Jesus gave strict orders that no one should know about this, and He told them to give her something to eat.

6.web: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.
6.kjv: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
6.bsb: Jesus went on from there and came to His hometown, accompanied by His disciples.

6.web: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?
6.kjv: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
6.bsb: When the Sabbath came, He began to teach in the synagogue, and many who heard Him were astonished. “Where did this man get these ideas?” they asked. “What is this wisdom He has been given? And how can He perform such miracles?

6.web: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary, and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” They were offended at him.
6.kjv: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
6.bsb: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and the brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? Aren’t His sisters here with us as well?” And they took offense at Him.

6.web: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”
6.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
6.bsb: Then Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown, among his relatives, and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”

6.web: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people, and healed them.
6.kjv: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them .
6.bsb: So He could not perform any miracles there, except to lay His hands on a few of the sick and heal them.

6.web: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.
6.kjv: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
6.bsb: And He was amazed at their unbelief. And He went around from village to village, teaching the people.

6.web: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.
6.kjv: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
6.bsb: Then Jesus called the Twelve to Him and began to send them out two by two, giving them authority over unclean spirits.

6.web: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,
6.kjv: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
6.bsb: He instructed them to take nothing but a staff for the journey—no bread, no bag, no money in their belts—

6.web: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.
6.kjv: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
6.bsb: and to wear sandals, but not a second tunic.

6.web: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.
6.kjv: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.
6.bsb: And He told them, “When you enter a house, stay there until you leave that area.

6.web: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”
6.kjv: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
6.bsb: If anyone will not welcome you or listen to you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that place, as a testimony against them.”

6.web: They went out and preached that people should repent.
6.kjv: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
6.bsb: So they set out and preached that the people should repent.

6.web: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick, and healed them.
6.kjv: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them .
6.bsb: They also drove out many demons and healed many of the sick, anointing them with oil.

6.web: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”
6.kjv: And king Herod heard of him ; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
6.bsb: Now King Herod heard about this, for Jesus’ name had become well known, and people were saying, “John the Baptist has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”

6.web: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”
6.kjv: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
6.bsb: Others were saying, “He is Elijah,” and still others, “He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of old.”

6.web: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”
6.kjv: But when Herod heard thereof , he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.
6.bsb: But when Herod heard this, he said, “John, whom I beheaded, has risen from the dead!”

6.web: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.
6.kjv: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife: for he had married her.
6.bsb: For Herod himself had ordered that John be arrested and bound and imprisoned, on account of his brother Philip’s wife Herodias, whom Herod had married.

6.web: For John said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”
6.kjv: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother’s wife.
6.bsb: For John had been telling Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife!”

6.web: Herodias set herself against him, and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,
6.kjv: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:
6.bsb: So Herodias held a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But she had been unable,

6.web: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.
6.kjv: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
6.bsb: because Herod feared John and protected him, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man. When he heard John’s words, he was greatly perplexed; yet he listened to him gladly.

6.web: Then a convenient day came, that Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.
6.kjv: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;
6.bsb: On Herod’s birthday, her opportunity arose. Herod held a banquet for his nobles and military commanders and the leading men of Galilee.

6.web: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”
6.kjv: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
6.bsb: When the daughter of Herodias came and danced, she pleased Herod and his guests, and the king said to the girl, “Ask me for whatever you wish, and I will give it to you.”

6.web: He swore to her, “Whatever you shall ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”
6.kjv: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
6.bsb: And he swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half my kingdom!”

6.web: She went out, and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”
6.kjv: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
6.bsb: Then she went out and asked her mother, “What should I request?” And her mother answered, “The head of John the Baptist.”

6.web: She came in immediately with haste to the king, and asked, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”
6.kjv: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.
6.bsb: At once the girl hurried back to the king with her request: “I want you to give me the head of John the Baptist on a platter immediately.”

6.web: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths, and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.
6.kjv: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath’s sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
6.bsb: The king was consumed with sorrow, but because of his oaths and his guests, he did not want to refuse her.

6.web: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard, and commanded to bring John’s head, and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
6.kjv: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
6.bsb: So without delay, the king commanded that John’s head be brought in. He sent an executioner, who went and beheaded him in the prison.

6.web: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.
6.kjv: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
6.bsb: The man brought John’s head on a platter and presented it to the girl, who gave it to her mother.

6.web: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
6.kjv: And when his disciples heard of it , they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
6.bsb: When John’s disciples heard about this, they came and took his body and placed it in a tomb.

6.web: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.
6.kjv: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.
6.bsb: Meanwhile, the apostles gathered around Jesus and brought Him news of all they had done and taught.

6.web: He said to them, “You come apart into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
6.kjv: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
6.bsb: And He said to them, “Come with Me privately to a solitary place, and let us rest for a while.” For many people were coming and going, and they did not even have time to eat.

6.web: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.
6.kjv: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.
6.bsb: So they went away in a boat by themselves to a solitary place.

6.web: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.
6.kjv: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.
6.bsb: But many people saw them leaving and recognized them. They ran together on foot from all the towns and arrived before them.

6.web: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd, and he began to teach them many things.
