6.kjv: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
6.bsb: When Jesus stepped ashore and saw a large crowd, He had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd. And He began to teach them many things.

6.web: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him, and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.
6.kjv: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:
6.bsb: By now the hour was already late. So the disciples came to Jesus and said, “This is a desolate place, and the hour is already late.

6.web: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages, and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”
6.kjv: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
6.bsb: Dismiss the crowd so they can go to the surrounding countryside and villages and buy themselves something to eat.”

6.web: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread, and give them something to eat?”
6.kjv: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?
6.bsb: But Jesus told them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked Him, “Should we go out and spend two hundred denarii to give all of them bread to eat?”

6.web: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”
6.kjv: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
6.bsb: “Go and see how many loaves you have,” He told them. And after checking, they said, “Five—and two fish.”

6.web: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.
6.kjv: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
6.bsb: Then Jesus directed them to have the people sit in groups on the green grass.

6.web: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.
6.kjv: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
6.bsb: So they sat down in groups of hundreds and fifties.

6.web: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.
6.kjv: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
6.bsb: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, Jesus spoke a blessing and broke the loaves. Then He gave them to His disciples to set before the people. And He divided the two fish among them all.

6.web: They all ate, and were filled.
6.kjv: And they did all eat, and were filled.
6.bsb: They all ate and were satisfied,

6.web: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.
6.kjv: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.
6.bsb: and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces of bread and fish.

6.web: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.
6.kjv: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
6.bsb: And there were five thousand men who had eaten the loaves.

6.web: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat, and to go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.
6.kjv: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.
6.bsb: Immediately Jesus made His disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of Him to Bethsaida, while He dismissed the crowd.

6.web: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.
6.kjv: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.
6.bsb: After bidding them farewell, He went up on the mountain to pray.

6.web: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.
6.kjv: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
6.bsb: When evening came, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and Jesus was alone on land.

6.web: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea, and he would have passed by them,
6.kjv: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
6.bsb: He could see that the disciples were straining to row, because the wind was against them. About the fourth watch of the night, Jesus went out to them, walking on the sea. He intended to pass by them,

6.web: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;
6.kjv: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
6.bsb: but when they saw Him walking on the sea, they cried out, thinking He was a ghost—

6.web: for they all saw him, and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them, and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
6.kjv: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
6.bsb: for they all saw Him and were terrified. But Jesus spoke up at once: “Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.”

6.web: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;
6.kjv: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
6.bsb: Then He climbed into the boat with them, and the wind died down. And the disciples were utterly astounded,

6.web: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.
6.kjv: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.
6.bsb: for they had not understood about the loaves, but their hearts had been hardened.

6.web: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret, and moored to the shore.
6.kjv: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
6.bsb: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret and moored the boat.

6.web: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,
6.kjv: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,
6.bsb: As soon as they got out of the boat, the people recognized Jesus

6.web: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick, on their mats, to where they heard he was.
6.kjv: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
6.bsb: and ran through that whole region, carrying the sick on mats to wherever they heard He was.

6.web: Wherever he entered, into villages, or into cities, or into the country, they laid the sick in the marketplaces, and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.
6.kjv: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
6.bsb: And wherever He went—villages and towns and countrysides—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged Him just to let them touch the fringe of His cloak. And all who touched Him were healed.

7.web: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.
7.kjv: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.
7.bsb: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes who had come from Jerusalem gathered around Jesus,

7.web: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.
7.kjv: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.
7.bsb: and they saw some of His disciples eating with hands that were defiled—that is, unwashed.

7.web: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews, don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.
7.kjv: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.
7.bsb: Now in holding to the tradition of the elders, the Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat until they wash their hands ceremonially.

7.web: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things, which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)
7.kjv: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.
7.bsb: And on returning from the market, they do not eat unless they wash. And there are many other traditions for them to observe, including the washing of cups, pitchers, kettles, and couches for dining.

7.web: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”
7.kjv: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?
7.bsb: So the Pharisees and scribes questioned Jesus: “Why do Your disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders? Instead, they eat with defiled hands.”

7.web: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
7.kjv: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
7.bsb: Jesus answered them, “Isaiah prophesied correctly about you hypocrites, as it is written: ‘These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.

7.web: But they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’
7.kjv: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
7.bsb: They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’

7.web: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”
7.kjv: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.
7.bsb: You have disregarded the commandment of God to keep the tradition of men.”

7.web: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.
7.kjv: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.
7.bsb: He went on to say, “You neatly set aside the command of God to maintain your own tradition.

7.web: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’
7.kjv: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:
7.bsb: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother’ and ‘Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.’

7.web: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban, that is to say, given to God”;’
7.kjv: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free .
7.bsb: But you say that if a man says to his father or mother, ‘Whatever you would have received from me is Corban’ (that is, a gift devoted to God),

7.web: then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,
7.kjv: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;
7.bsb: he is no longer permitted to do anything for his father or mother.

7.web: making void the word of God by your tradition, which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”
7.kjv: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.
7.bsb: Thus you nullify the word of God by the tradition you have handed down. And you do so in many such matters.”

7.web: He called all the multitude to himself, and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.
7.kjv: And when he had called all the people unto him , he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you , and understand:
7.bsb: Once again Jesus called the crowd to Him and said, “All of you, listen to Me and understand:

7.web: There is nothing from outside of the man, that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.
7.kjv: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.
7.bsb: Nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him; but the things that come out of a man, these are what defile him.”

7.web: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!”
7.kjv: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

7.web: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.
7.kjv: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.
7.bsb: After Jesus had left the crowd and gone into the house, His disciples inquired about the parable.

7.web: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,
7.kjv: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;
7.bsb: “Are you still so dull?” He asked. “Do you not understand? Nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him,

7.web: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, thus purifying all foods?”
7.kjv: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?
7.bsb: because it does not enter his heart, but it goes into the stomach and then is eliminated.” (Thus all foods are clean.)

7.web: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.
7.kjv: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.
7.bsb: He continued: “What comes out of a man, that is what defiles him.

7.web: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,
7.kjv: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,
7.bsb: For from within the hearts of men come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery,

7.web: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.
7.kjv: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:
7.bsb: greed, wickedness, deceit, debauchery, envy, slander, arrogance, and foolishness.

7.web: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.”
7.kjv: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
7.bsb: All these evils come from within, and these are what defile a man.”

7.web: From there he arose, and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house, and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.
7.kjv: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it : but he could not be hid.
7.bsb: Jesus left that place and went to the region of Tyre. Not wanting anyone to know He was there, He entered a house, but was unable to escape their notice.

7.web: For a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.
7.kjv: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
7.bsb: Instead, a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit soon heard about Jesus, and she came and fell at His feet.

7.web: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.
7.kjv: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.
7.bsb: Now she was a Greek woman of Syrophoenician origin, and she kept asking Jesus to drive the demon out of her daughter.

7.web: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”
7.kjv: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children’s bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.
7.bsb: “First let the children have their fill,” He said. “For it is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”

7.web: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
7.kjv: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children’s crumbs.
7.bsb: “Yes, Lord,” she replied, “even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”

7.web: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”
7.kjv: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.
7.bsb: Then Jesus told her, “Because of this answer, you may go. The demon has left your daughter.”

7.web: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.
7.kjv: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
7.bsb: And she went home and found her child lying on the bed, and the demon was gone.

7.web: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee, through the middle of the region of Decapolis.
7.kjv: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.
7.bsb: Then Jesus left the region of Tyre and went through Sidon to the Sea of Galilee and into the region of the Decapolis.

7.web: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.
7.kjv: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.
7.bsb: Some people brought to Him a man who was deaf and hardly able to speak, and they begged Jesus to place His hand on him.

7.web: He took him aside from the multitude, privately, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spat, and touched his tongue.
7.kjv: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;
7.bsb: So Jesus took him aside privately, away from the crowd, and put His fingers into the man’s ears. Then He spit and touched the man’s tongue.

7.web: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”
7.kjv: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
7.bsb: And looking up to heaven, He sighed deeply and said to him, “Ephphatha!” (which means, “Be opened!”).

7.web: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.
7.kjv: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
7.bsb: Immediately the man’s ears were opened and his tongue was released, and he began to speak plainly.

7.web: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.
7.kjv: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it ;
7.bsb: Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone. But the more He ordered them, the more widely they proclaimed it.

7.web: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear, and the mute speak!”
7.kjv: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
7.bsb: The people were utterly astonished and said, “He has done all things well! He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”

8.web: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself, and said to them,
8.kjv: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him , and saith unto them,
8.bsb: In those days the crowd once again became very large, and they had nothing to eat. Jesus called the disciples to Him and said,

8.web: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days, and have nothing to eat.
8.kjv: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:
8.bsb: “I have compassion for this crowd, because they have already been with Me three days and have nothing to eat.

8.web: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”
8.kjv: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.
8.bsb: If I send them home hungry, they will faint along the way. For some of them have come a great distance.”

8.web: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”
8.kjv: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?
8.bsb: His disciples replied, “Where in this desolate place could anyone find enough bread to feed all these people?”

8.web: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”
8.kjv: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.
8.bsb: “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied.

8.web: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them, and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.
8.kjv: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them ; and they did set them before the people.
8.bsb: And He instructed the crowd to sit down on the ground. Then He took the seven loaves, gave thanks and broke them, and gave them to His disciples to set before the people. And they distributed them to the crowd.

8.web: They had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.
8.kjv: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them .
8.bsb: They also had a few small fish, and Jesus blessed them and ordered that these be set before them as well.

8.web: They ate, and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.
8.kjv: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.
8.bsb: The people ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

8.web: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.
8.kjv: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
8.bsb: And about four thousand men were present. As soon as Jesus had dismissed the crowd,

8.web: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples, and came into the region of Dalmanutha.
8.kjv: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
8.bsb: He got into the boat with His disciples and went to the district of Dalmanutha.

8.web: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven, and testing him.
8.kjv: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.
8.bsb: Then the Pharisees came and began to argue with Jesus, testing Him by demanding from Him a sign from heaven.

8.web: He sighed deeply in his spirit, and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”
8.kjv: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
8.bsb: Jesus sighed deeply in His spirit and said, “Why does this generation demand a sign? Truly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”

8.web: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.
8.kjv: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.
8.bsb: And He left them, got back into the boat, and crossed to the other side.

8.web: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.
8.kjv: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
8.bsb: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, except for one loaf they had with them in the boat.

8.web: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”
8.kjv: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.
8.bsb: “Watch out!” He cautioned them. “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of Herod.”

8.web: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”
8.kjv: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.
8.bsb: So they began to discuss with one another the fact that they had no bread.

8.web: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet, neither understand? Is your heart still hardened?
8.kjv: And when Jesus knew it , he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?
8.bsb: Aware of their conversation, Jesus asked them, “Why are you debating about having no bread? Do you still not see or understand? Do you have such hard hearts?

8.web: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?
8.kjv: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?
8.bsb: ‘Having eyes, do you not see? And having ears, do you not hear?’ And do you not remember?

8.web: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”
8.kjv: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
8.bsb: When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces did you collect?” “Twelve,” they answered.

8.web: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”
8.kjv: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.
8.bsb: “And when I broke the seven loaves for the four thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces did you collect?” “Seven,” they said.

8.web: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”
8.kjv: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?
8.bsb: Then He asked them, “Do you still not understand?”

8.web: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him, and begged him to touch him.
8.kjv: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
8.bsb: When they arrived at Bethsaida, some people brought a blind man and begged Jesus to touch him.

8.web: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.
8.kjv: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.
8.bsb: So He took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the village. Then He spit on the man’s eyes and placed His hands on him. “Can you see anything?” He asked.

8.web: He looked up, and said, “I see men; for I see them like trees walking.”
8.kjv: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
8.bsb: The man looked up and said, “I can see the people, but they look like trees walking around.”

8.web: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.
8.kjv: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.
8.bsb: Once again Jesus placed His hands on the man’s eyes, and when he opened them his sight was restored, and he could see everything clearly.

8.web: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”
8.kjv: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.
8.bsb: Jesus sent him home and said, “Do not go back into the village.”

8.web: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”
8.kjv: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Cæsarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?
8.bsb: Then Jesus and His disciples went on to the villages around Caesarea Philippi. On the way, He questioned His disciples: “Who do people say I am?”

8.web: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others: one of the prophets.”
8.kjv: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say , Elias; and others, One of the prophets.
8.bsb: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, one of the prophets.”

8.web: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”
8.kjv: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.
8.bsb: “But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”

8.web: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.
8.kjv: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
8.bsb: And Jesus warned them not to tell anyone about Him.

8.web: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
8.kjv: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
8.bsb: Then He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and that He must be killed and after three days rise again.

8.web: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
8.kjv: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
8.bsb: He spoke this message quite frankly, and Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him.

8.web: But he, turning around, and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”
8.kjv: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.
8.bsb: But Jesus, turning and looking at His disciples, rebuked Peter and said, “Get behind Me, Satan! For you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men.”

8.web: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples, and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
8.kjv: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
8.bsb: Then Jesus called the crowd to Him along with His disciples, and He told them, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.

8.web: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.
8.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel’s, the same shall save it.
8.bsb: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake and for the gospel will save it.

8.web: For what does it profit a man, to gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?
8.kjv: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
8.bsb: What does it profit a man to gain the whole world, yet forfeit his soul?

8.web: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?
8.kjv: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
8.bsb: Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?

8.web: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him, when he comes in his Father’s glory, with the holy angels.”
8.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
8.bsb: If anyone is ashamed of Me and My words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will also be ashamed of him when He comes in His Father’s glory with the holy angels.”

9.web: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”
9.kjv: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.
9.bsb: Then Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, there are some standing here who will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God arrive with power.”

9.web: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.
9.kjv: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.
9.bsb: After six days Jesus took with Him Peter, James, and John, and led them up a high mountain by themselves. There He was transfigured before them.

9.web: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.
9.kjv: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.
9.bsb: His clothes became radiantly white, brighter than any launderer on earth could bleach them.

9.web: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.
9.kjv: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
9.bsb: And Elijah and Moses appeared before them, talking with Jesus.

9.web: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
9.kjv: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
9.bsb: Peter said to Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

9.web: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.
9.kjv: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
9.bsb: For they were all so terrified that Peter did not know what else to say.

9.web: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”
9.kjv: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
9.bsb: Then a cloud appeared and enveloped them, and a voice came from the cloud: “This is My beloved Son. Listen to Him!”

9.web: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.
9.kjv: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
9.bsb: Suddenly, when they looked around, they saw no one with them except Jesus.

9.web: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
9.kjv: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.
9.bsb: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus admonished them not to tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

9.web: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.
9.kjv: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.
9.bsb: So they kept this matter to themselves, discussing what it meant to rise from the dead.

9.web: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
9.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?
9.bsb: And they asked Jesus, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

9.web: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?
9.kjv: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.
9.bsb: He replied, “Elijah does indeed come first, and he restores all things. Why then is it written that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected?

9.web: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”
9.kjv: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.
9.bsb: But I tell you that Elijah has indeed come, and they have done to him whatever they wished, just as it is written about him.”

9.web: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.
9.kjv: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.
9.bsb: When they returned to the other disciples, they saw a large crowd around them, and scribes arguing with them.

9.web: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.
9.kjv: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
9.bsb: As soon as all the people saw Jesus, they were filled with awe and ran to greet Him.

9.web: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”
9.kjv: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?
9.bsb: “What are you disputing with them?” He asked.

9.web: One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;
9.kjv: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;
9.bsb: Someone in the crowd replied, “Teacher, I brought You my son, who has a spirit that makes him mute.

9.web: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down, and he foams at the mouth, and grinds his teeth, and wastes away. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren’t able.”

9.web: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.”

9.bsb: “O unbelieving generation!” Jesus replied. “How long must I remain with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy to Me.”

9.web: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him, and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.
9.kjv: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
9.bsb: So they brought him, and seeing Jesus, the spirit immediately threw the boy into a convulsion. He fell to the ground and rolled around, foaming at the mouth.

9.web: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has come to him?” He said, “From childhood.

9.bsb: Jesus asked the boy’s father, “How long has this been with him?” “From childhood,” he said.

9.web: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water, to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us, and help us.”
9.kjv: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.
9.bsb: “It often throws him into the fire or into the water, trying to kill him. But if You can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”

9.web: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”
9.kjv: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
9.bsb: “If You can?” echoed Jesus. “All things are possible to him who believes!”

9.web: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”
9.kjv: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
9.bsb: Immediately the boy’s father cried out, “I do believe; help my unbelief!”

9.web: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”
9.kjv: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
9.bsb: When Jesus saw that a crowd had come running, He rebuked the unclean spirit. “You deaf and mute spirit,” He said, “I command you to come out and never enter him again.”

9.web: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead; so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”
9.kjv: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.
9.bsb: After shrieking and convulsing him violently, the spirit came out. The boy became like a corpse, so that many said, “He is dead.”

9.web: But Jesus took him by the hand, and raised him up; and he arose.
9.kjv: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.
9.bsb: But Jesus took him by the hand and helped him to his feet, and he stood up.

9.web: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”
9.kjv: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?
9.bsb: After Jesus had gone into the house, His disciples asked Him privately, “Why couldn’t we drive it out?”

9.web: He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing, except by prayer and fasting.”
9.kjv: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
9.bsb: Jesus answered, “This kind cannot come out, except by prayer.”

9.web: They went out from there, and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it.

9.bsb: Going on from there, they passed through Galilee. But Jesus did not want anyone to know,

9.web: For he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”
9.kjv: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.
9.bsb: because He was teaching His disciples. He told them, “The Son of Man will be delivered into the hands of men. They will kill Him, and after three days He will rise.”

9.web: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.
9.kjv: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
9.bsb: But they did not understand this statement, and they were afraid to ask Him about it.

9.web: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”
9.kjv: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?
9.bsb: Then they came to Capernaum. While Jesus was in the house, He asked them, “What were you discussing on the way?”

9.web: But they were silent, for they had disputed one with another on the way about who was the greatest.
9.kjv: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.
9.bsb: But they were silent, for on the way they had been arguing about which of them was the greatest.

9.web: He sat down, and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”
9.kjv: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
9.bsb: Sitting down, Jesus called the Twelve and said, “If anyone wants to be first, he must be the last of all and the servant of all.”

9.web: He took a little child, and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,
9.kjv: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,
9.bsb: Then He had a little child stand among them. Taking the child in His arms, He said to them,

9.web: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name, receives me, and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”
9.kjv: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
9.bsb: “Whoever welcomes one of these little children in My name welcomes Me, and whoever welcomes Me welcomes not only Me, but the One who sent Me.”

9.web: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”
9.kjv: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.
9.bsb: John said to Him, “Teacher, we saw someone else driving out demons in Your name, and we tried to stop him, because he does not accompany us.”

9.web: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name, and be able quickly to speak evil of me.
9.kjv: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
9.bsb: “Do not stop him,” Jesus replied. “For no one who performs a miracle in My name can turn around and speak evil of Me.

9.web: For whoever is not against us is on our side.
9.kjv: For he that is not against us is on our part.
9.bsb: For whoever is not against us is for us.

9.web: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.
9.kjv: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.
9.bsb: Indeed, if anyone gives you even a cup of water because you bear the name of Christ, truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward.

9.web: Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.
9.kjv: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
9.bsb: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea.

9.web: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,
9.kjv: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
9.bsb: If your hand causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life crippled than to have two hands and go into hell, into the unquenchable fire.

9.web: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
9.kjv: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

9.web: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—
9.kjv: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
9.bsb: If your foot causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life lame than to have two feet and be thrown into hell.

9.web: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
9.kjv: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

9.web: If your eye causes you to stumble, cast it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,
9.kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:
9.bsb: And if your eye causes you to sin, pluck it out. It is better for you to enter the kingdom of God with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell,

9.web: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’
9.kjv: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
9.bsb: where ‘their worm never dies, and the fire is never quenched.’

9.web: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.
9.kjv: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.
9.bsb: For everyone will be salted with fire.

9.web: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”
9.kjv: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.
9.bsb: Salt is good, but if the salt loses its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt among yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”

10.web: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.
10.kjv: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judæa by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
10.bsb: Then Jesus left that place and went into the region of Judea, beyond the Jordan. Again the crowds came to Him and He taught them, as was His custom.

10.web: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”
10.kjv: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.
10.bsb: Some Pharisees came to test Him. “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?” they inquired.

10.web: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”
10.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
10.bsb: “What did Moses command you?” He replied.

10.web: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”
10.kjv: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
10.bsb: They answered, “Moses permitted a man to write his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away.”

10.web: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.
10.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.
10.bsb: But Jesus told them, “Moses wrote this commandment for you because of your hardness of heart.

10.web: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.
10.kjv: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.
10.bsb: However, from the beginning of creation, ‘God made them male and female.’

10.web: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,
10.kjv: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;
10.bsb: ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife,

10.web: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.
10.kjv: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.
10.bsb: and the two will become one flesh.’ So they are no longer two, but one flesh.

10.web: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”
10.kjv: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
10.bsb: Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”

10.web: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.
10.kjv: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter .
10.bsb: When they were back inside the house, the disciples asked Jesus about this matter.

10.web: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife, and marries another, commits adultery against her.
10.kjv: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.
10.bsb: So He told them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.

10.web: If a woman herself divorces her husband, and marries another, she commits adultery.”
10.kjv: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.
10.bsb: And if a woman divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.”

10.web: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.
10.kjv: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them .
10.bsb: Now people were bringing the little children to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them, and the disciples rebuked those who brought them.

10.web: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation, and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.
10.kjv: But when Jesus saw it , he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
10.bsb: But when Jesus saw this, He was indignant and told them, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

10.web: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
10.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.
10.bsb: Truly I tell you, anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”

10.web: He took them in his arms, and blessed them, laying his hands on them.
10.kjv: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
10.bsb: And He took the children in His arms, placed His hands on them, and blessed them.

10.web: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”
10.kjv: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
10.bsb: As Jesus started on His way, a man ran up and knelt before Him. “Good Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to inherit eternal life?”

10.web: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.
10.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is , God.
10.bsb: “Why do you call Me good?” Jesus replied. “No one is good except God alone.

10.web: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’”
10.kjv: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.
10.bsb: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness, do not cheat others, honor your father and mother.’”

10.web: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”
10.kjv: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.
10.bsb: “Teacher,” he replied, “all these I have kept from my youth.”

10.web: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.”
10.kjv: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.
10.bsb: Jesus looked at him, loved him, and said to him, “There is one thing you lack: Go, sell everything you own and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”

10.web: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.
10.kjv: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.
10.bsb: But the man was saddened by these words and went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.

10.web: Jesus looked around, and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!”

10.bsb: Then Jesus looked around and said to His disciples, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!”

10.kjv: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!
10.bsb: And the disciples were amazed at His words. But Jesus said to them again, “Children, how hard it is to enter the kingdom of God!

10.kjv: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
10.bsb: It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”

10.web: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”
10.kjv: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?
10.bsb: They were even more astonished and said to one another, “Who then can be saved?”

10.web: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”
10.kjv: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
10.bsb: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but not with God. For all things are possible with God.”

10.web: Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all, and have followed you.”
10.kjv: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.

10.web: Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News,

10.web: But many who are first will be last; and the last first.”
10.kjv: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.
10.bsb: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.”

10.web: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.

10.bsb: As they were going up the road to Jerusalem, Jesus was walking ahead of them. The disciples were amazed, but those who followed were afraid. Again Jesus took the Twelve aside and began to tell them what was going to happen to Him:

10.web: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.
10.kjv: Saying , Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:
10.bsb: “Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and scribes. They will condemn Him to death and will deliver Him over to the Gentiles,

10.web: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”
10.kjv: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
10.bsb: who will mock Him and spit on Him and flog Him and kill Him. And after three days He will rise again.”

10.web: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”
10.kjv: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.
10.bsb: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to Jesus and declared, “Teacher, we want You to do for us whatever we ask.”

10.web: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”
10.kjv: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?
10.bsb: “What do you want Me to do for you?” He inquired.

10.web: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand, and one at your left hand, in your glory.”
10.kjv: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.
10.bsb: They answered, “Grant that one of us may sit at Your right hand and the other at Your left in Your glory.”

10.web: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”
10.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?
10.bsb: “You do not know what you are asking,” Jesus replied. “Can you drink the cup I will drink, or be baptized with the baptism I will undergo?”

10.web: They said to him, “We are able.” Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;
10.kjv: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:
10.bsb: “We can,” the brothers answered. “You will drink the cup that I drink,” Jesus said, “and you will be baptized with the baptism that I undergo.

10.web: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”
10.kjv: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.
10.bsb: But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant. These seats belong to those for whom they have been prepared.”

10.web: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant towards James and John.
10.kjv: And when the ten heard it , they began to be much displeased with James and John.
10.bsb: When the ten heard about this, they became indignant with James and John.

10.web: Jesus summoned them, and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
10.kjv: But Jesus called them to him , and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.
10.bsb: So Jesus called them together and said, “You know that those regarded as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their superiors exercise authority over them.

10.web: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.
10.kjv: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:
10.bsb: But it shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,

10.web: Whoever of you wants to become first among you, shall be bondservant of all.
10.kjv: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.
10.bsb: and whoever wants to be first must be the slave of all.

10.web: For the Son of Man also came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
10.kjv: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
10.bsb: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.”

10.web: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho, with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.
10.kjv: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimæus, the son of Timæus, sat by the highway side begging.
10.bsb: Next, they came to Jericho. And as Jesus and His disciples were leaving Jericho with a large crowd, a blind beggar named Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, was sitting beside the road.

10.web: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out, and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
10.kjv: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
10.bsb: When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”

10.web: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
10.kjv: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
10.bsb: Many people admonished him to be silent, but he cried out all the louder, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”

10.web: Jesus stood still, and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”
10.kjv: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
10.bsb: Jesus stopped and said, “Call him.” So they called the blind man. “Take courage!” they said. “Get up! He is calling for you.”

10.web: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.
10.kjv: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.
10.bsb: Throwing off his cloak, Bartimaeus jumped up and came to Jesus.

10.web: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”
10.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.
10.bsb: “What do you want Me to do for you?” Jesus asked. “Rabboni,” said the blind man, “let me see again.”

10.web: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus on the way.
10.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
10.bsb: “Go,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you.” And immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus along the road.

11.web: When they came near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
11.kjv: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,
11.bsb: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent out two of His disciples

11.web: and said to them, “Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him, and bring him.
11.kjv: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him .
11.bsb: and said to them, “Go into the village ahead of you, and as soon as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, on which no one has ever sat. Untie it and bring it here.

11.web: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs him;’ and immediately he will send him back here.”
11.kjv: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.
11.bsb: If anyone asks, ‘Why are you doing this?’ tell him, ‘The Lord needs it and will return it shortly.’”

11.web: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.
11.kjv: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.
11.bsb: So they went and found the colt outside in the street, tied at a doorway. They untied it,

11.web: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”
11.kjv: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?
11.bsb: and some who were standing there asked, “Why are you untying the colt?”

11.web: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.
11.kjv: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.
11.bsb: The disciples answered as Jesus had instructed them, and the people gave them permission.

11.web: They brought the young donkey to Jesus, and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.
11.kjv: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.
11.bsb: Then they led the colt to Jesus and threw their cloaks over it, and He sat on it.

11.web: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees, and spreading them on the road.
11.kjv: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
11.bsb: Many in the crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others spread branches they had cut from the fields.

11.web: Those who went in front, and those who followed, cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!
11.kjv: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
11.bsb: The ones who went ahead and those who followed were shouting: “Hosanna!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!”

11.web: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
11.kjv: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
11.bsb: “Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!” “Hosanna in the highest!”

11.web: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.
11.kjv: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.
11.bsb: Then Jesus entered Jerusalem and went into the temple courts. He looked around at everything, but since it was already late, He went out to Bethany with the Twelve.

11.web: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.
11.kjv: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
11.bsb: The next day, when they had left Bethany, Jesus was hungry.

11.web: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.
11.kjv: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet .
11.bsb: Seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, He went to see if there was any fruit on it. But when He reached it, He found nothing on it except leaves, since it was not the season for figs.

11.web: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.
11.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.
11.bsb: Then He said to the tree, “May no one ever eat of your fruit again.” And His disciples heard this statement.

11.web: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple, and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables, and the seats of those who sold the doves.
11.kjv: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
11.bsb: When they arrived in Jerusalem, Jesus entered the temple courts and began to drive out those who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling doves.

11.web: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.
11.kjv: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.
11.bsb: And He would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple courts.

11.web: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations?’ But you have made it a den of robbers!”
11.kjv: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
11.bsb: Then Jesus began to teach them, and He declared, “Is it not written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’”

11.web: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.
11.kjv: And the scribes and chief priests heard it , and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.
11.bsb: When the chief priests and scribes heard this, they looked for a way to kill Him. For they were afraid of Him, because the whole crowd was astonished at His teaching.

11.web: When evening came, he went out of the city.
11.kjv: And when even was come, he went out of the city.
11.bsb: And when evening came, Jesus and His disciples went out of the city.

11.web: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.
11.kjv: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
11.bsb: As they were walking back in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered from its roots.

11.web: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”
11.kjv: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
11.bsb: Peter remembered it and said, “Look, Rabbi! The fig tree You cursed has withered.”

11.web: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.
11.kjv: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.
11.bsb: “Have faith in God,” Jesus said to them.

11.web: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening; he shall have whatever he says.
11.kjv: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
11.bsb: “Truly I tell you that if anyone says to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ and has no doubt in his heart but believes that it will happen, it will be done for him.

11.web: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.
11.kjv: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them , and ye shall have them .
11.bsb: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.

11.web: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.
11.kjv: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
11.bsb: And when you stand to pray, if you hold anything against another, forgive it, so that your Father in heaven will forgive your trespasses as well.”
